tool_signatures.name: add_users_to_audience
tool_signatures.description: Add users to a custom audience. Payload must be a JSON string containing hashed user data with a schema array defining the data types (e.g. EMAIL, PHONE, FN, LN).

tool_signatures.description: Copy an existing ad. Creates a duplicate within the same or different ad set.

tool_signatures.name: create_ad
tool_signatures.description: Create a new ad. Requires name, adset_id, and creative (JSON object_story_spec). Defaults to PAUSED status.

creative.description: JSON string of creative spec (object_story_spec with page_id, link_data/photo_data/video_data). Note: as of v26.0, a creative with applink_treatment=web_only can no longer be attached to an ad in a campaign using Website and App conversion locations — use automatic destination selection or a compatible manual destination instead.

tracking_specs.description: JSON string of tracking specs array

parameters.name: creative
parameters.description: JSON string of creative spec (object_story_spec with page_id, link_data/photo_data/video_data). Note: as of v26.0, a creative with applink_treatment=web_only can no longer be attached to an ad in a campaign using Website and App conversion locations — use automatic destination selection or a compatible manual destination instead.

parameters.name: tracking_specs
parameters.description: JSON string of tracking specs array

tool_signatures.description: Get details of a specific ad by ID.

tool_signatures.name: get_ad_account

tool_signatures.description: Get a preview of an ad in a specific format. Returns HTML iframe for rendering.

tool_signatures.name: get_delivery_estimate
tool_signatures.description: Get delivery estimate for an ad set, including estimated daily reach. Note: the delivery_estimate edge exists on the ad set (and ad account) node, not on individual ads. Also note: as of v26.0, the daily_outcomes_curve, budget_guardrail, and estimate_dau fields are no longer returned (removed with no replacement).
